choices.why: A light grey three-seater with clean wide arms, exactly the 'gris claro' sofa asked for, with a simple modern shape that suits the long left wall.
A large 170x240 cream shag rug that defines the seating zone and warms the grey wood-look floor while keeping the room bright.
A light ash coffee table with slim tapered legs that is modern, airy and the right size for the rug.
A low, long, off-white TV console on slim legs that blends with the white walls and keeps the look light and modern.
A sleek floor lamp with a white rectangular shade and brushed metal base that adds soft light in the corner by the sofa without visual clutter.
Two green linen-look cushions bring a fresh pop of color to the grey sofa and echo the plant.
A tall areca palm fills the spot by the balcony door with lush greenery and suits the bright light there.
White sheer curtains soften the black sliding frame while letting the daylight pour in.

answer.why: A palette of light grey, cream, white and pale ash keeps the living room bright and modern against the white walls and grey floor. The green cushions and palm add the color the user wanted, tied together as one fresh accent.
